policy.reproducibility: Input SHA-256s are authoritative; generated outputs have no timestamp or self-referential output commit.
policy.sourceReferences: source resolves through sources[id] to repository path and SHA-256; pointer is RFC 6901. catalogRows and dictionaryRow index the catalog FM3_PARAMS and dictionary params arrays.
policy.measurement: A point only proves its recorded firmware/type/channel/value scope. No interpolation or cross-model/channel promotion.
policy.encoder: Table availability requires policy, supported kind and a bundled base layout; composer support is separately declared.
policy.limitations: Remaining historical evidence mining and non-parameter features remain in work-queue.json. Zero indexed points means not indexed, not unmeasured or unsupported.
policy.hardware: No device import, audio or CPU testing was performed by this audit.
